text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: B

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ackgrounds regulate whether a

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: single-colour signature may be in

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: positive or reverse form. The positive

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: form, black on white, is preferred for

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: its superior legibility. Also, to maintain con-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: sistency across the company, it should be

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: your first choice. The descriptions and exam-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ples below set out the background standards

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: for all of our signatures.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 1 is the preferred single-colour form

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: for all signatures: positive form, black on

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: white.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 2 depicts the case where a white

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: background is not feasible. A black signature

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: is used but the background must be no more

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: than 20% value. The size is enlarged, com-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: pared with example 1, to compensate for the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: loss of contrast.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 3 shows the case where for some

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: reason black is not available to use on a signa-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ture. The least desirable of these three positive

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: forms, a signature may be rendered in colour

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: but the colour must have a value of 70% or

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: more and the background must be white.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 4 illustrates a signature

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: in

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: its best

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: reverse form: white on black. Less desirable

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: than its black on white counterpart at top, it

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: needs considerable enlargement to ensure

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: legibility.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 5 shows the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: minimum

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: background

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: value for a reverse signature: 80% value. The

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: size is enlarged, compared with example 4, to

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: compensate for the loss of contrast
